    it = iter(data)

    K1 = next(it)

        y = next(it) - 1
        bus[x].append(y)
        bus[y].append(x)

    B = next(it) - 1

    dist[N + A] = 1

    dq.append(N + A)

                    dq.appendleft(ns)

                dist[ns] = nd
                dq.append(ns)

    elif d2 == -1:
        print(d1 * P)

        print(min(d1, d2) * P)
